# quickvanrecv

Receives a file with the Quick-VAN protocol.

```ttl
quickvanrecv
```

## Remarks

Causes Tera Term to receive a file from the host with the Quick-VAN protocol. Pauses until the end of the file transfer. If the file is transferred successfully, the system variable "result" is set to 1. Otherwise, "result" is set to zero.

Receiving files are saved in [file transfer folder](https://teratermproject.github.io/manual/5/en/html/setup/folder.html#filedir).

## Example

```ttl
quickvansend 'readme.txt'
```
